//: The generator DERIVES its table list from the `import { ... } from "../db/schema"`
statements in backend/src, so a table already imported does not belong here.
This list exists for the chicken-and-egg case only: a table you are about to start
using through Drizzle cannot be imported until it is in the artifact.
Add it here, regenerate (docs/schema-artifact.md), then write the import.
Foreign-key targets are pulled automatically - `companies` arrives because
project_brands references it, not because anyone listed it.
